summary: AppFlowy is an open-source alternative to Notion designed for managing tasks, notes, and project structures. It enables you to organise lists and track the status of multiple workflows in a self-hosted environment.
goodFor: Teams and individuals who want a locally hosted workspace for task management and project organisation without relying on proprietary cloud services.
watchOut: The AGPL-3.0 licence places copyleft requirements on your modifications if you distribute the software, and the feature set closely mirrors larger established ecosystems.
deployNotes: Deployment typically involves Docker containers, requiring persistent volumes for your stored data and a standard reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
